title: Convert Seconds to Minutes and Seconds
question: Read a non-negative number of seconds and display the equivalent minutes and remaining seconds.
code:
total_seconds = int(input("Seconds: "))
minutes = total_seconds // 60
seconds = total_seconds % 60
print(f"{minutes} minute(s), {seconds} second(s)")
explanation: Integer division finds whole minutes; modulo gives the remaining seconds.
